deviations_from_paper.explanation: Every evidence item is a character range into an emitted text file; verify.py re-slices it and recomputes the share that still matches.

envelope.note: closed-list phrase edits plus spacing; every claim-bearing token audited

envelope.condition: a draft plus a polished candidate (llm mode)
envelope.note: the candidate is audited, never rewritten
headings, tables and fenced blocks are passed through verbatim

failure_modes.mode: candidate drops a number, unit or citation
failure_modes.impact: audit fails that class and lists the missing tokens
reported as a preservation violation rather than silently accepted
reported under alignment.dropped_text; not treated as a failure

note: This is a skill-authoring challenge: the targets are the demonstration benchmark and the audit, not a paper's reported numbers.
